D5_r1_A.head: c515cfcbb852871f42e60f0defb73bda5891b5f6
D5_r1_A.brief: Help our team explore how to rebuild customer trust. Support says unreliable releases matter most; Sales believes the bigger issue is confusing packaging; Product worries that a feature freeze would lose important customers. These are competing interpretations, not established facts. We have two months to learn, and are not choosing a final strategy today. Preserve the disagreement, expand our ideas and suggest a few small experiments.

D3_r1_A.head: c515cfcbb852871f42e60f0defb73bda5891b5f6
D3_r1_A.brief: We have 400 paying customers at £20 per customer per month. We want monthly recurring revenue to rise by at least 15% within three months. We could raise the price to £22, keep the price and improve onboarding, or offer annual contracts. Customer interviews suggest that raising the price could cause 10–20% churn, but that evidence is weak. We have £1,000 available for one-off research. Help us model the trade-offs and avoid counting the same revenue twice.

D5_r1_A_corrected.head: c1e944a453b6d8a9bb3e90da75cc2ebb2c3decf7
D5_r1_A_corrected.brief: Help our team explore how to rebuild customer trust. Support says unreliable releases matter most; Sales believes the bigger issue is confusing packaging; Product worries that a feature freeze would lose important customers. These are competing interpretations, not established facts. We have two months to learn, and are not choosing a final strategy today. Preserve the disagreement, expand our ideas and suggest a few small experiments.
